Tenancy is in the schema. Every other table has shop_id NOT NULL → shops.id. Every foreign key includes shop_id (so does every primary key except jobs'), so a row in one shop cannot point at a row in another.

Row-level security is FORCEd on the 9 tables marked RLS: a row is visible only when shop_id = app.current_shop, set per transaction (none set → no rows). The app role is not a superuser, has no BYPASSRLS and no DELETE.
